description: This file defines an abstract class 'AbstractCommandStrategies' which manages command strategies in a persistent actor context. It provides mechanisms to register, select, and invoke command handling strategies based on command types, facilitating strategy delegation within a command-processing framework.

classes.name: AbstractCommandStrategies
classes.description: An abstract class that manages a collection of command strategies, delegating command handling based on command class types.

methods.name: getEmptyResult
methods.description: Abstract method to return an empty result of type R.

methods.name: addStrategy
methods.description: Adds a command strategy to the internal strategies map. Should be called from constructor.

methods.name: unhandled
methods.description: Logs that a command cannot be handled and returns an empty result.

methods.name: isDefined
methods.description: Checks if a command class has a registered strategy.

methods.name: doApply
methods.description: Executes the appropriate command strategy for a given command, or calls unhandled if none is found.

methods.name: getAppropriateStrategy
methods.description: Retrieves the command strategy matching the given command class.
